comment: As long as you take good notes you'll do well in this class. All lectures were written on the board in a step by step explanation process, attendance isn't super mandatory as long as you get the notes from a peer you'll be ok
Funny and caring guy, class is based around 6 quizzes and one cumulative homework grade. He is very accessible and understanding, so it's ok if you mess a few things up. Homework is optional too

Dr. McGuire is great. He gives clear lectures and allows students to ask questions about previous material/homework before he begins his lectures. The homework is optional and he only counts the homework if it helps your grade. He also makes jokes throughout class to help keep class entertaining.

Dr. McGuire is great. He's very relaxed and is always cracking jokes during lectures. His Abst Math class was easy to a fault to get an A in, but he did encourage retention. The take-home exams allowed him to ask difficult questions - some well beyond the scope of the class - but he graded nicely. Plus, he used a free textbook for it. He cool :)

i was really struggling as I didn't take calc in HS and have always been bad at math in general. Then i started to see him outside of class and he helped so much. this guy truly wants his students to succeed. He's the man! 10/10 teacher. I used to hate math and be uncomfortable with it, but after this class my comprehension has increased so much.

best professor i've had so far. super straightforward tests. homework is optional (he only includes it if it helps your grade) but even if you choose to do it it's online and doesn't take much time. very quirky guy in the best way
easy class, homework isn't required but it'll help your grade if you do it, attendance is not required either. in addition to that, mcguire is a funny guy

Nice guy and easy class. He doesn't require attendance, so if you're confident in the material, you don't need to show up. There are online HW, but you don't need to do it if you get a good grade on the test. Basically, the grade you get for the class depends on about 5 tests, and if you consistently did your hw, he will bump your grade up
Easy class to do well in and attendance isn't mandatory
